usps.title: 50+ Quality Checks
usps.detail: Every device goes through 50+ rigorous quality checkpoints — battery, display, speakers, cameras, buttons, sensors, water resistance seals. Nothing leaves without passing ALL checks.

usps.title: 6-12 Month Warranty
usps.detail: Full warranty coverage on every device. Not some shady verbal promise — proper documented warranty with service support.

usps.title: Government IMEI Verification
usps.detail: Partnership with C-DOT and Sanchar Saathi for official government IMEI verification. Your device is 100% legit, verified by the Indian government itself.

usps.title: Premium at Smart Price
usps.detail: Get the exact same Apple experience — same iOS, same ecosystem, same build quality — at 30-50% less. The phone doesn't know it's refurbished.

usps.title: Physical Stores
usps.detail: 6 stores across Delhi NCR where you can touch, feel, and test before buying. Not some random Instagram seller — walk into a proper store.

target_audience.primary: 18-35 year old Indians who want Apple but find new prices too high
target_audience.secondary: Parents buying first premium phone for college-going kids
target_audience.tertiary: Professionals upgrading who want value for money

brand_voice.tone: Confident, relatable, slightly cheeky — like a smart friend who found a hack
avoid: Making claims we can't back up
embrace: Relatable scenarios from Indian daily life
Subtle flex energy — 'smart choice, not compromise'
Humor that lands with Gen Z and millennials
Real talk about money and aspirations

content_philosophy.core_belief: Every piece of content should tell a story first. The brand should feel like a natural part of that story, not the reason the story exists.
content_philosophy.inspiration: Think Tanmay Bhat doing a brand deal — the content is genuinely entertaining, and the brand mention feels earned, not forced.
content_philosophy.hooks: First 2 seconds must create curiosity or pattern-interrupt. No slow intros.
